chapter: Fourteen years with Nat Cole and the recording sessions
title: Classical guitar study, teaching Stanley Morgan, and his guitarist daughter
summary: Collins studies classical guitar for technique, took lessons from Vince Macaluso, and mentions his daughter, a nun and classical guitarist.

blocks.x: Well, that was when you were into studying the classical --
Or maybe you always had been.

Yeah, yeah, yeah. Well, I dabble in that, I study that now periodically now. As a matter of fact I just finished a little series of classical lessons. You know, I do it for technique, and I do it for motivation, you know. And to -- I like it, you know, so I get into a lot of things.
Then I know you were studying (with Stanley Morgan, more (inaudible).
No, I taught Stanley Morgan. I remember.
You taught. You used to go over to Stanley's house and (play guitar) (inaudible).

Who -- I was studying recently with a guitarist, a young guitarist, a tremendous classical guitarist [Macaluso] by the name of Vince Macalooso. Now, I tell you now I heard him. I have a daughter who's a nun and who's a very fine guitarist, oh, she's a very fine guitarist, classical, nothing but classics. And she was studying with Vince and she happened to tell me about him, and I went out to hear him and I heard him and so I decided to take a few lessons, you know. And I enjoyed it, you know, so I do this periodically. But my daughter's a very fine guitarist also. She's in the convent.
She still has time to play ?
